I'm turning the two findings into JSON: AC5 in the story and the error-handling entry for status changes on one side, the status-change endpoint on the other. The PRD lists three statuses, Open, In Progress and Completed, so I'm sticking with those, and I'm weighing whether the endpoint should accept all three or only Completed as its required transition, with the accepted values stated clearly.

I'm settling the status values now: the PRD has Open, In Progress and Completed, so the endpoint will accept those three and reject anything else, and I'll update the story's invalid-status criterion to match. Next I'm working out the endpoint and error-handling task details and what the story's remaining fields should say.
